title: chant release changed output
description: What `chant release changed --json` prints (#5134): the members of a workspace of separately released members that a release at a commit has to cut, in publish order, each with why. A member is `paths-changed` when paths changed since its last release (minus `changes.ignore` and generated files) or it has none; the closure adds each changed dependency of a member (`needed-by`) and each dependent whose last published range does not admit a member's next label (`range-broken-by`). It reads local refs and tags and never fetches. Version 1 of the read contract. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version. The codes are a closed list, each in the one closed list of `reason-codes.ts`. Contract version 1 of this document is written by chant 0.124.100 and newer.

at.description: The full sha the read was made at.

members.description: In publish order: layer, then name.

layer.description: The dependency layer; members of one layer publish together, after every earlier layer.

member.description: The member that needs this one (`needed-by`) or whose next label breaks its range (`range-broken-by`); null for `paths-changed`.

last.description: The member's last release, or null when it has none.

source.description: A cut in the member's ledger, or a legacy tag named by `release.legacyTags`.

bump.description: The bump applied to the last label: `--bump-member`, else patch.

next.description: The label a release would carry, or null when there is no last label to bump.

paths.description: The changed paths that count, from the outermost workspace root. Empty for a member taken only by the closure.

bumpFrom.description: Added within contract version 1 by #5159. Where bump came from: flag for --bump-member, commits or intents for the higher of the conventional commits over paths since the last release and the pending intent files (commits when they tie), default for a patch when neither gives one.

intents.description: Added within contract version 1 by #5159. The intent files under .chant/release/ that name the member and that no cut of it consumed, by path from the repository root.
